not_verified: Only R35 is met on this branch; the other 40 T53 marks (R1-R6, R8-R14, R16, R18, R19, R21, R25-R34, R36-R55) are untouched in this attempt: they are the provider-neutral turn/adapter layer, and R1/R6 change converse's contract that agent-worker calls, so they need their own attempt(s). R35 is NOT registered with ai-runs: that needs code outside agent-model. (1) owner agent-worker: keep a persistent {get, put} circuit handle (e.g. DO storage) per Worker, record each turn's class with circuitRecord(handle, account, entry_id, class|null) and admit with circuitAdmit (R53's turn integration is not built yet, so today the circuit only moves if the Worker calls these), and answer a health read: health(account_id, entry_id, {circuit: handle, entryOf: aiCatalogue.entryOf}) from agent-model/src/health.mjs. (2) owner plane (ai-runs wiring at the plane's start, where env.AGENT_WORKER is bound): aiRunsOf(ctx).registerPathReady('agent-model', ({account_id, entry_id}) => <read of (1) over AGENT_WORKER>), or, if the plane holds the circuit itself, registerPathReady('agent-model', pathSource({circuit, entryOf})). Until (2) lands, ai-runs' #pathReady stays fail-closed (unregistered). Parameters BREAKER_FAILURES=5 and BREAKER_COOLDOWN_MS=30000 are the draft's proposed values, not set at START. Entry lifecycle 'lapsed' reads 'retired' (fail closed); a what-if for BOB.
